sources.title: OpenAI model catalog
sources.support: Current hosted reasoning/vision model IDs and advertised price tiers; provider claims, not EDI measurements.

sources.title: Claude model overview
sources.support: Current reasoning, vision and tool-use lineup; vendor latency labels are not matched EDI measurements.

sources.title: Gemini model catalog
sources.support: Current multimodal model lineup and endpoint names; verify account and regional availability at binding.

sources.title: Qwen3.5-9B model card
sources.support: Small open-weight multimodal candidate; deployment and task quality require qualification.

sources.title: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B model card
sources.support: Vision encoder plus language model, 35B total/3B active parameters; active parameters do not determine resident weight memory.

sources.title: DeepSeek-V4 preview
sources.support: Pro/Flash reasoning alternatives and API IDs; do not infer unlisted modality support.

sources.title: Docling supported formats
sources.support: Structured document conversions; source-native retention remains necessary.

sources.title: FFmpeg documentation
sources.support: Media stream conversion; explicit stream/time mapping is an EDI contract.

sources.title: Splink documentation
sources.support: Probabilistic linkage for structured records; not universal cross-modal physical identity.

sources.title: Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B
sources.support: Text embeddings; retrieval representation must remain versioned and separate from identity.

sources.title: Qwen3-VL-Embedding-2B
sources.support: Multimodal retrieval candidate; alignment is not causal or identity proof.

sources.title: PostgreSQL JSON types
sources.support: JSON/JSONB storage; preserve original bytes outside normalized JSONB.

sources.title: PostgreSQL transaction isolation
sources.support: Transaction semantics and retry obligations; bitemporal semantics are application-owned.

sources.title: pgvector
sources.support: Exact/approximate vector search and filtered-recall considerations.

sources.title: Graphiti
sources.support: Incremental temporal context graphs and provenance; automatic invalidation needs EDI admission controls.

sources.title: Microsoft GraphRAG
sources.support: Graph-oriented retrieval/indexing; repository currently states maintenance mode and indexing cost caution.

sources.title: LightRAG
sources.support: Alternative graph-assisted retrieval implementation; not an executable dynamics engine.

sources.title: Neo4j graph database
sources.support: Property graph representation and traversal; does not supply response laws by itself.

sources.title: W3C SHACL
sources.support: RDF shape validation; shape validity is distinct from empirical truth.

sources.title: LangGraph persistence
sources.support: Thread checkpoints versus cross-thread stores; neither defines EDI knowledge admission.

sources.title: Temporal workflows
sources.support: Durable workflow service alternative for later operational complexity.

sources.title: ReAct
sources.support: Research pattern for interleaving reasoning and tool actions; not a guarantee of true mechanisms.

sources.title: Tree of Thoughts
sources.support: Explicit branching/search alternative; token and evaluation costs need controls.

sources.title: DSPy
sources.support: Program/prompt optimization alternative once reliable development examples and metrics exist.

sources.title: PySD
sources.support: Vensim/XMILE translation and system-dynamics simulation, with documented unsupported functions.

sources.title: SciPy solve_ivp
sources.support: ODE methods, event roots, stiff/nonstiff distinctions; not a universal delay/DAE solver.

sources.title: SimPy
sources.support: Discrete-event process simulation; continuous and hybrid coupling must be specified separately.

sources.title: Mesa
sources.support: Agent-based modeling; modeled humans need evidence-qualified rules.

sources.title: Tigramite
sources.support: Time-series causal discovery with method-specific assumptions, including stationarity and confounding distinctions.

sources.title: DoWhy
sources.support: Causal effect identification, estimation and refutation under explicit assumptions.

sources.title: PySINDy
sources.support: Sparse nonlinear system identification; library and measurement choices are priors.

sources.title: PyMC overview
sources.support: Bayesian modeling and inference; prior/likelihood specification remains a modeling obligation.

sources.title: PyMC predictive checks
sources.support: Prior/posterior predictive checks; a good fit does not uniquely identify structure.

sources.title: Chronos forecasting
sources.support: Chronos-2 pretrained numerical forecasting, including covariates; not causal intervention evidence.

sources.title: TimesFM
sources.support: Current repository lists TimesFM 3.0 with separately restricted weights; 2.5 weights retain Apache-2.0 per repository notice.

sources.title: BoTorch
sources.support: Bayesian optimization and acquisition functions; EDI experiment utility and constraints must be supplied.

sources.title: CVXPY
sources.support: Convex optimization modeling; nonlinear nonconvex dynamics require an appropriate alternative or qualification.

sources.title: OR-Tools
sources.support: Constraint/discrete optimization candidate; model feasibility is not real-world feasibility.

sources.title: V-JEPA 2
sources.support: Representative latent video prediction/planning research; scope does not establish a general social/ecological world model.

sources.title: DreamerV3
sources.support: Representative learned world-model RL across task environments; reward, experience and interface assumptions still apply.

sources.title: VIME
sources.support: Information-gain exploration research; does not prescribe EDI's multi-objective inquiry scheduler.

sources.title: MAPIE
sources.support: Conformal prediction intervals and risk-control tooling; guarantees depend on the chosen method and assumptions.

sources.title: River ADWIN
sources.support: Adaptive-window drift detector; an alert does not identify a causal change.

sources.title: Pydantic strict mode
sources.support: Typed boundary validation; schema correctness does not establish semantic or causal correctness.

sources.title: Pint
sources.support: Units and dimensional calculations; source interpretation and conversions must remain explicit.

sources.title: vLLM structured outputs
sources.support: Constrained-output serving candidate; syntax compliance is not factual validation.

sources.title: OpenAI structured outputs
sources.support: Schema-constrained output capability; refusal, truncation and semantic validation require handling.

sources.title: OpenTelemetry
sources.support: Operational observability; use complete path cost and failure accounting.

sources.title: SQLAlchemy
sources.support: SQL Core/ORM persistence tooling; inspected documentation identifies 2.1 as current and 2.0 as maintenance.

sources.title: Alembic
sources.support: Versioned SQL schema migrations; EDI model-semantic migration is a separate operation.

sources.title: FastAPI
sources.support: Optional HTTP boundary; an in-process port remains the first implementation form.

sources.title: TypeSafe Jev release and benchmark qualifications
sources.support: Vendor-reported focused-decision latency and evaluation qualifications, including geography and request/workflow construction; not EDI measurements.

sources.title: TypeSafe decision primitives
sources.support: Focused typed judgments, known choices, independent questions and dependent follow-ups; bounded output type does not establish causal truth.

sources.title: TypeSafe state
sources.support: Shared structured state for independent judgments; choose only relevant grounded context.

sources.title: TypeSafe confidence
sources.support: Confidence is computed from the output distribution; application thresholds and model behavior require task-specific validation.

sources.title: TypeSafe speculative fan-out
sources.support: Batching independent potential questions; dependency chains and total request budget remain relevant.

sources.title: Materialize fundamentals
sources.support: Incrementally maintained streaming results, built on Timely/Differential Dataflow; optional infrastructure, not EDI model semantics.

sources.title: PostgreSQL table partitioning
sources.support: Physical table partitioning/pruning under compatible workloads; no automatic graph-sharding or universal latency guarantee.

sources.title: PostgreSQL materialized views
sources.support: Persisted query results and explicit refresh; not automatic incremental maintenance of an evolving world model.

sources.title: TypeSafe models and version aliases
sources.support: Versioned releases versus moving aliases, request shape and limits; bind and qualify the actual provider model/version before execution.

sources.title: uv workspace documentation
sources.support: Shared lockfile/workspace behavior and limits when package environments conflict.

sources.title: Ruff documentation
sources.support: Python linting/formatting; development tool performance is not EDI runtime performance.

sources.title: Hypothesis stateful tests
sources.support: Generated state-machine operation sequences for invariant/recovery tests; no scientific correctness guarantee.

sources.title: Diffrax getting started
sources.support: JAX differential-equation tools including ODE/SDE/CDE; exact operators and numerical semantics need binding.

sources.title: NumPyro getting started
sources.support: JAX-based probabilistic inference including MCMC and variational methods; model/likelihood assumptions remain explicit.

sources.title: sbi documentation
sources.support: Simulation-based parameter inference; posterior quality depends on simulator, prior and training/validation.

sources.title: SALib documentation
sources.support: Morris, Sobol and other sensitivity methods; their input-dependence assumptions need qualification.

sources.title: PySR project
sources.support: Symbolic expression search with a Julia backend; an equation fit does not identify causal structure.

sources.title: SUNDIALS IDA documentation
sources.support: DAE solver family; backend bindings, initialization, operator capabilities and platform support are not established by reading documentation.

sources.title: SymPy project
sources.support: Symbolic mathematics as a reusable backend, not an EDI model authority or empirical validator.

sources.title: Z3 guide
sources.support: Logical formula satisfiability under supported theories; formal consistency is distinct from external truth.

sources.title: Polars documentation
sources.support: Columnar data manipulation and lazy/streaming execution; measure actual query, memory and copy costs.

sources.title: DuckDB project
sources.support: Embedded analytical SQL and file analysis; proposed read/analysis role, not a duplicate authoritative world store.

sources.title: Modelica language specification 3.6
sources.support: Equation-based composition interoperability reference; this cited version is not claimed to be the newest release.

sources.title: libRoadRunner documentation
sources.support: SBML simulation candidate; inspected landing docs are older and explicitly exclude algebraic rules and delay equations, so installed capabilities must be qualified.

sources.title: JAX thinking in JAX
sources.support: Array JIT and shape restrictions; warm-up/shape change costs matter for an evolving world.

sources.title: PyO3 user guide
sources.support: Rust/Python extension interface for profiled kernels; no automatic whole-system speedup.

sources.title: pytest documentation
sources.support: Fixtures and functional test execution; infrastructure checks do not establish intelligence.

sources.title: Pyright project
sources.support: Python static typing; type checking is separate from semantic/evidence validation.

sources.title: SBML specifications
sources.support: Systems-biology model exchange standards; each imported model and operator subset needs provenance and qualification.

sources.title: CasADi documentation
sources.support: Differentiation, numerical optimization and ODE/DAE/control building blocks; existing models may require a different encoding.

sources.title: SciPy bounded nonlinear least squares
sources.support: Bounded local residual optimization; a local optimum does not establish identification or a correct mechanism.

sources.title: NetworkX documentation
sources.support: Reference graph analysis algorithms; not selected as the durable full-world memory representation.

sources.title: DSPy project
sources.support: A language-model programming framework candidate; task metrics, optimization splits and original outcome evidence remain EDI responsibilities.
